purpose.text: to verify your identity including but not limited to handling and processing your instructions, complaints and requests related to the above
purpose.name: authentication

purpose.text: to verify your eligibility for our offers for Services, games and/or promotions or other events
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to process your application to subscribe to our Services and loyalty programmes operated by us and/or any members of the PCCW Group
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to provide, activate and/or renew Services, loyalty programmes operated by us or any members of the HKT Group
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to process any payment instructions, direct debit facilities and/or credit facilities in relation to our supply of Services to you, including but not limited to handling and processing your instructions, complaints and request related to the above
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to provide you with rewards, promotional benefits, updates, offer and invitation to events
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text:
to promote and market our Services to you through different means, including but not limited to the use of machine learning and/or artificial intelligence tools and/or models (collectively, the “
AI
”)
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: to perform research or analyses so that we may improve and optimise the Services and/or loyalty programmes that can be made available to you, such as through AI
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to conduct surveys and marketing, promotional, behavioural scoring for business operations, your needs and preferences and/or planning purposes, such as through the use of AI, and carry out behavioural, market and product analyses for profiling, generating statistical or actuarial reports (containing aggregated data that does not relate to any identified or identifiable individual), information management and database administration
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to maintain, enhance and develop various products and service offerings through different means, including but not limited to the use of AI
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to distribute our publications and research materials as well as those of our business partners and counterparties
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: to maintain and develop our systems and infrastructure, including testing and upgrading of these systems
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to carry out matching procedures, as defined under the applicable Data Protection Laws
purpose.name: compliance

purpose.text: to carry out market and product analyses in order to generate statistical or actuarial reports (containing aggregated data that does not relate to any identified or identifiable individual)
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to develop financial services and products
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to conduct credit checks and detect fraudulent activities in compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance (Cap. 615 of the laws of Hong Kong) and in relation to other compliance purposes
purpose.name: fraud detection

purpose.text: to enforce our contractual rights and statutory rights
purpose.name: legal compliance

purpose.text: to comply with our obligations under the Broadcasting Ordinance (Cap.562) and our television programme service licence(s)
purpose.name: compliance

purpose.text: to evaluate your financial needs and insurance claims made by or against you, and to process claims involving you (including but not limited to making, defending, analysing, investigating, processing, assessing, determining, responding to, resolving or settling such claims)
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to comply with applicable laws in or outside Hong Kong as may be required by applicable government authorities, courts, law enforcement, or regulatory or investigation bodies, in relation to the supply of Services and/or loyalty programmes to you, including to assist in the investigation, prevention, detection of crime or possible criminal activities
purpose.name: legal compliance

references.text: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance (Cap. 615 of the laws of Hong Kong)

purpose.text: to verify your identity including but not limited to handling and processing your instructions, complaints and requests related to the above
purpose.name: authentication

purpose.text: to verify your eligibility for our offers for Services, games and/or promotions or other events
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to process your application to subscribe to our Services and loyalty programmes operated by us and/or any members of the PCCW Group
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to provide, activate and/or renew Services, loyalty programmes operated by us or any members of the HKT Group
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to process any payment instructions, direct debit facilities and/or credit facilities in relation to our supply of Services to you, including but not limited to handling and processing your instructions, complaints and request related to the above
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to provide you with rewards, promotional benefits, updates, offer and invitation to events
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text:
to promote and market our Services to you through different means, including but not limited to the use of machine learning and/or artificial intelligence tools and/or models (collectively, the “
AI
”)
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: to perform research or analyses so that we may improve and optimise the Services and/or loyalty programmes that can be made available to you, such as through AI
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to conduct surveys and marketing, promotional, behavioural scoring for business operations, your needs and preferences and/or planning purposes, such as through the use of AI, and carry out behavioural, market and product analyses for profiling, generating statistical or actuarial reports (containing aggregated data that does not relate to any identified or identifiable individual), information management and database administration
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to maintain, enhance and develop various products and service offerings through different means, including but not limited to the use of AI
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to distribute our publications and research materials as well as those of our business partners and counterparties
purpose.name: marketing

purpose.text: to maintain and develop our systems and infrastructure, including testing and upgrading of these systems
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to carry out matching procedures, as defined under the applicable Data Protection Laws
purpose.name: compliance

purpose.text: to carry out market and product analyses in order to generate statistical or actuarial reports (containing aggregated data that does not relate to any identified or identifiable individual)
purpose.name: analytics

purpose.text: to develop financial services and products
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to conduct credit checks and detect fraudulent activities in compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance (Cap. 615 of the laws of Hong Kong) and in relation to other compliance purposes
purpose.name: fraud detection

purpose.text: to enforce our contractual rights and statutory rights
purpose.name: legal compliance

purpose.text: to comply with our obligations under the Broadcasting Ordinance (Cap.562) and our television programme service licence(s)
purpose.name: compliance

purpose.text: to evaluate your financial needs and insurance claims made by or against you, and to process claims involving you (including but not limited to making, defending, analysing, investigating, processing, assessing, determining, responding to, resolving or settling such claims)
purpose.name: service provision

purpose.text: to comply with applicable laws in or outside Hong Kong as may be required by applicable government authorities, courts, law enforcement, or regulatory or investigation bodies, in relation to the supply of Services and/or loyalty programmes to you, including to assist in the investigation, prevention, detection of crime or possible criminal activities
purpose.name: legal compliance

references.text: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance (Cap. 615 of the laws of Hong Kong)
